dane generate.help:
Usage of dane generate:
  -cert string
    	Path to PEM-encoded certificate file
  -hostname string
    	Mail server hostname (e.g., mail.example.com)
  -matching int
    	TLSA matching type: 0=exact, 1=SHA-256 (default), 2=SHA-512 (default 1)
  -selector int
    	TLSA selector: 0=full cert, 1=SPKI (default 1) (default 1)
  -usage int
    	TLSA usage: 2=DANE-TA, 3=DANE-EE (default 3) (default 3)

backup-db.help:
Usage of backup-db:
  -access-key string
    	S3 access key; refused on the command line (set BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY or pass --access-key-file)
  -access-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 access key
  -bucket string
    	Backup bucket name
  -dsn string
    	PostgreSQL DSN (defaults to owner-first DB_*_DSN precedence)
  -dump-hmac-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the dump-authentication HMAC key (required: binds every uploaded dump so restore can verify it fail-closed before pg_restore runs)
  -endpoint string
    	S3 endpoint (host or https://host)
  -provider string
    	S3 provider (e.g. minio, aws)
  -region string
    	S3 region
  -secret-key string
    	S3 secret key; refused on the command line (set BACKUP_SECRET_KEY or pass --secret-key-file)
  -secret-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 secret key

restore.help:
Usage of restore:
  -access-key string
    	S3 access key; refused on the command line (set BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY or pass --access-key-file)
  -access-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 access key
  -bucket string
    	Backup bucket name
  -control-socket string
    	local setup control Unix socket
  -dry-run
    	Preview only (POST /setup/preflight)
  -dsn string
    	PostgreSQL DSN for pg_restore (type=full; defaults to owner-first DB_*_DSN precedence)
  -dump-hmac-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the dump-authentication HMAC key (required for type=full: verifies the dump's published binding fail-closed before pg_restore runs)
  -endpoint string
    	S3 endpoint (host or https://host)
  -hashes string
    	Comma-separated blob hashes (type=blobs)
  -provider string
    	S3 provider
  -region string
    	S3 region
  -secret-key string
    	S3 secret key; refused on the command line (set BACKUP_SECRET_KEY or pass --secret-key-file)
  -secret-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 secret key
  -type string
    	Restore scope: full | config | blobs (default "full")
  -yes
    	Skip the destructive-restore confirmation

exchange-a0 registry.help:
Usage of exchange-a0 registry:
  -output string
    	write the embedded v0 registry to a new file

exchange-a0 validate.help:
Usage of exchange-a0 validate:
  -input string
    	A0/v0 collector JSON

exchange-a0 report.help:
Usage of exchange-a0 report:
  -generated-at string
    	canonical UTC RFC3339 time (test/reproduction override)
  -input string
    	A0/v0 collector JSON
  -locale string
    	zh-CN or en-US (default "zh-CN")
  -output string
    	new output directory
  -pdf
    	also render report.pdf with locally installed Microsoft Edge

exchange-a0 attest.help:
Usage of exchange-a0 attest:
  -actor string
    	named attesting actor
  -decision string
    	accepted|rejected for handling; go|no-go|defer for decision-use
  -issued-at string
    	canonical UTC RFC3339 time
  -kind string
    	handling or decision-use
  -organization string
    	attesting organization
  -output string
    	new receipt JSON path
  -purpose string
    	real handling or decision purpose
  -report string
    	report.json path
  -retention-days int
    	accepted local retention in days

exchange-a0 verify-receipt.help:
Usage of exchange-a0 verify-receipt:
  -receipt string
    	A0/v0 receipt JSON
  -report string
    	bound report.json

exchange assess collect.override_error: usage: mailctl exchange assess collect --input collector.json --output DIR [--resume checkpoint.json]

exchange assess report.override_error: usage: mailctl exchange assess report <bundle.sja> --output <new-dir> [--format html,json]

exchange assess import.override_error: usage: mailctl exchange assess import <bundle.sja> --project-id ID [--server URL] [--json]

backup create.help:
Usage of backup create:
  -access-key string
    	S3 access key
  -access-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 access key
  -bucket string
    	backup bucket
  -dsn string
    	direct owner PostgreSQL DSN
  -endpoint string
    	S3 endpoint
  -json
    	JSON output
  -pre-upgrade
    	create or verify a transactional-upgrade recovery set
  -protected-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the protected-configuration recovery key
  -protected-key-id string
    	non-secret protected-key identifier (default "db-encryption-key")
  -provider string
    	S3 provider
  -reason string
    	audit reason (default "create pre-upgrade application recovery point")
  -recovery-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the recovery-set HMAC key
  -region string
    	S3 region
  -secret-key string
    	S3 secret key
  -secret-key-file string
    	0600 file containing the S3 secret key
  -timeout duration
    	backup completion timeout (default 10m0s)
